projectDescription: A Rust procedural macro crate that provides a convenient derive macro for implementing std::error::Error on struct and enum error types.
keyFeatures: Derive macro for std::error::Error trait on structs and enums
Automatic Display impl generation via #[error("...")] attribute
Automatic From impl generation via #[from] attribute for error conversion
Backtrace capture support via Backtrace field detection
Zero cost: does not appear in public API, equivalent to hand-written impls
Support for enums, named-field structs, tuple structs, and unit structs
Format string interpolation with field shorthands
